title: Partial upgrades break Arch rolling release systems
description: Running pacman -Sy <pkg> without updating the entire system causes shared library ABI mismatches.

title: Configuration files are saved as .pacnew instead of overwriting
description: Upgrades never overwrite existing modified configs, producing .pacnew files.
recommendation: Use DIFF tools or pacdiff to review and merge .pacnew files.
do_not_do: Do not ignore accumulating .pacnew files as they contain critical new defaults.

title: makepkg and AUR helpers must run as non-root user
description: Arch Linux forbids makepkg or AUR helpers (yay/paru) from running as root.
recommendation: Execute AUR builds under regular user privileges.
do_not_do: Never run sudo makepkg or sudo yay.
